tools.name: get_networks
tools.description: The EVM networks where Soheil Router is live: chain id, name, our contract, its fee and fee wallet, and the contracts a trade may call. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_api_info
tools.description: What the Soheil Router API is: version, router fee, the most an integrator may add, how keys are given, and where the docs and OpenAPI spec are. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The best price for a token swap on one network, or a transfer to another network (bridge), and the transaction that makes it, through our contract. Returns toAmount, toAmountMin (enforced on-chain), the fees, approvalAddress (approve it for exactly fromAmount first unless fromToken is the coin) and

tools.name: get_trade_status
tools.description: Where a sent trade stands, from its transaction on chain: PENDING, DONE (with what was paid and received; for a bridge, once paid on the destination), REFUNDED (a bridge transfer paid back on the source network), FAILED, NOT_FOUND or NOT_OURS. Needs an API key.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
